condition: The Do ordinal token renders as "17o" instead of "17th" when the advancedFormat plugin is missing, or when it comes from a localized format such as LL and advancedFormat was extended before localizedFormat.
workaround: Extend the advancedFormat plugin, which is what handles Do, and extend localizedFormat after it so that LL-style formats are expanded before Do is processed. Alternatively, build the string by hand with localeData().ordinal(date.date()) and remove the brackets.
